metadata.question: Did sea surface temperatures in the Arabian Sea reach at least 30 degrees Celcius in June of 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NOAA OISST V2.1 daily SST (global, °C). Filter to June 1–July 1, 2023 and to an Arabian Sea bounding box (45E–75E, 5N–25N). If empty, widen date window.
2. Masking strategy: OISST is gap-filled; land/ice are masked natively. No cloud masking needed.
3. Valid vs Null: Compute monthly max SST over the region; check valid pixel count (>0). If result is null/NaN or outside plausible SST range (-3 to 50 °C), return C3. Threshold: max SST >= 30°C => Yes.
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function getInfo(obj) {
  return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
      [[[45.0, 5.0], [75.0, 5.0], [75.0, 25.0], [45.0, 25.0], [45.0, 5.0]]],
      null, false
    );
    const start = '2023-06-01';
    const end = '2023-07-01';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    let col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/OISST/V2_1')
      .filterDate(start, end)
      .filterBounds(geom)
      .select(['sst']);
    let size = await getInfo(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      // Recovery attempt: slightly widen date range
      const start2 = '2023-05-25';
      const end2 = '2023-07-05';
      col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/OISST/V2_1')
        .filterDate(start2, end2)
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .select(['sst']);
      size = await getInfo(col.size());
      console.log(`Initial Images: 0; Widened Range Images: ${size}`);
      if (size === 0) {
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    } else {
      console.log(`Images (2023-06): ${size}`);
    }

    // 3. Processing: compute per-month maximum SST and pixel count
    const monthMax = col.max(); // max SST across June 2023
    const stats = monthMax.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.min(), sharedInputs: true})
               .combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true})
               .combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}),
      geometry: geom,
      scale: 25000,
      maxPixels: 1e9,
      bestEffort: true
    });

    const sstMax = await getInfo(stats.get('sst_max'));
    const sstMin = await getInfo(stats.get('sst_min'));
    const sstMean = await getInfo(stats.get('sst_mean'));
    const pixCount = await getInfo(stats.get('sst_count'));

    if (!pixCount || pixCount === 0) {
      console.log('Valid Pixels: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalid = (sstMax === null || isNaN(sstMax) || sstMax < -3 || sstMax > 50);
    console.log(`Valid Pixels: ${pixCount}`);
    console.log(`SST Max (°C): ${sstMax !== null ? sstMax.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`);
    console.log(`SST Min (°C): ${sstMin !== null ? sstMin.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`);
    console.log(`SST Mean (°C): ${sstMean !== null ? sstMean.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`);

    if (invalid) {
      console.log('C3');
    } else if (sstMax >= 30.0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
